title: App-versus-network isolation
first_five_minutes: Compare synthetic probe success from multiple AZs
Check TLS handshake and DNS resolution separately
Correlate with ingress 5xx vs upstream timeout
stop_escalation: Escalate to network if multi-AZ probes fail
Escalate if only one AZ fails (infra)
do_not_do_yet: Do not open wide NetworkPolicy temporarily
isolation_logic: If in-cluster peer health works but edge fails, prefer ingress/TLS; if both fail, prefer network or cluster DNS.
